analysis: This patient exhibits a relapsing-remitting pattern of neutropenia (Grade 1-3), along with transient thrombocytopenia and thyroid dysfunction (hyper- then hypothyroidism). The constellation suggests immune-mediated cytopenias and endocrinopathy, possibly related to immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy. Despite these adverse events, the patient maintains ECOG 1 and no evidence of progressive multi-organ failure. The risk profile is moderate, with good functional status and manageable toxicities.
evidences: Recurrent grade 3 neutropenia without infectious complications
Stable performance status (ECOG 1) throughout the observation period
